Digital Innovation

We Build the Tools We Inspect With

Every report this practice produces comes out of software we designed and built ourselves — so findings are captured the same way on every job, by every inspector.

Rating System

One rating, traceable from site to report

We rate every defect using BARIS — the Building Assessment Rating & Inspection System used by RISM and JKR. It combines condition severity with repair urgency into a single rating, so a repair plan can be ordered by priority instead of by opinion.

1Good
2Fair
3Poor
4Bad
5Dilapidated
Inspection Platform

GoInspect — the platform behind every report

Designed and built in-house. Every residential report we issue is produced with it, on phone or laptop.

  • Floor-plan taggingPin each defect on the plan with its photo
  • Submission modeReview and submit defects for developer approval
  • Re-inspection modeBefore and after status for every defect
  • Offline modeInspect without signal, sync later
  • Contractor and defect formsWork orders by trade for repairers
  • Maintenance plannerPriorities, trades and cost per item
  • Ayie, AI assistantAnswers inspection questions on site

For Homeowners

GoHomeIn development

A home companion for Malaysian buyers and owners — putting a building surveyor's knowledge into every step, from choosing a home to claiming defects after handover. 25 tools planned across four stages.
